title: Task 1 - Clause classification item
description: Given a clause and the full list of template labels, the model selects one label. Scored by exact match, and additionally at category level with near-duplicate templates collapsed (Jaccard >= 0.60).

id.description: Unique item id, of the form <template-name>-classify-01.

input.description: The clause text, with titles and headings stripped to prevent answer leakage.

labels.description: The complete candidate label set (one per template in the corpus), identical for every item.

expected_output.description: The gold template name. Must be a member of labels.
